# Sleeve accounting, curated and deduplicated (2026-10-29)

## SCOPE (InfinityBlade)

- Surface: one entry per real strategy, deduplicated across every desk roster in the crosswalk; arranged by TYPE, then family, then name.
- Constraints: a merge without evidence is a fabrication. Merges use evidence tiers A (documented grouping), B (exact id equality, implicit: the same id string is one alias), C (mechanical identity: desk naming differences only, with family/style/description corroboration). No Tier D judgment merges were needed beyond C; doubtful singletons stay separate and are flagged UNRESOLVED. Algorithm text is assembled only from recorded sources (Test catalog entry/variant fields, md2 catalog entry/exit/strategy text, lz_engine entry/exit/sizing configs, ausar_map params/variant text, muse-desk-v3 roster params/slices, femto land-wt config params). Where a source records only part of an algorithm the entry is marked PARTIAL and the gap is named. Nothing was invented.
- Outcome: every raw id appears exactly once, as an alias of one strategy or in the closing non-strategy section.
- Proof: counts below are computed from accounting.json after writing; alias total reconciles exactly to the crosswalk universe.

## Counts (reconciled in print)

- Raw sleeve ids in the crosswalk universe: **1565** (1,563 authoritative ids + the 2 named census artifacts `bars` and `id`, which sit in the non-strategy section; the 3 bta_onebar ids were added 2026-10-31 by the algorithm audit cure B from the live 336 roster, findings-b6-roster).
- Strategies: **654**
- Aliases across strategies: **1562**
- Non-strategy (monitor/recorder/artifact) ids, counted separately: **3**
- Check: 1562 + 3 = **1565** = raw ids. Exact.
- Merges by tier: A documented grouping: 752 union operations; C mechanical identity: 156; B exact-id is structural (one node per id string); D curated judgment: 0 (none asserted without A/C-grade evidence).
- UNRESOLVED entries (kept separate, never force-merged): **104** (listed in MERGES.md with what would settle each class).
- Algorithm completeness: FULL **650**, PARTIAL **4** (each PARTIAL entry names its specific gap). Updated 2026-10-31 by the algorithm audit cure A: fields filled only from cited findings evidence; FULL requires entry, exit, sizing, filters and parameters all present. Cure B (2026-10-31) added the 3 bta_onebar strategies as FULL from docs/BTA-ONEBAR-ALGORITHM.md and the live config rows (findings-b6-roster).

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [TRADER_DONCHIAN55] Entry candidates need at least 252 daily bars, a positive ATR14, and a positive 20-day average dollar volume. Entry condition: last close above the prior 55-day high (the maximum high of the 55 bars before the last bar) and last close above the 200-day SMA. Candidates are ranked by (close - prior55_high) / ATR14 descending, symbol ascending on ties; slots: 10. The entry intent is market, day, buy_to_open, with stop_price = round(price - 2.0 x ATR14, 4) recorded on the intent (ATR14 is Wilder RMA). Exits are evaluated first; if any exit is emitted, the evaluation returns with no entry.
- Exit rules:
  - [TRADER_DONCHIAN55] 1. Exits are evaluated first; if any exit is emitted, the evaluation returns with no entry. 2. Exit, initial stop: a held position whose last close is at or below its recorded stop_price (the entry 2xATR14 stop, read from the position or its meta) is sold in full. 3. Exit, timeout: a position held at least 126 completed holding bars is sold in full (reason `126_completed_holding_bars`). 4. Exit, signals (requires at least 252 bars): a last close below the prior 20-day low and/or below the 200-day SMA sells the position in full, with the triggered conditions named in the reason. Exits are market, day, sell_to_close intents, in full.
- Sizing:
  - [TRADER_DONCHIAN55] 8. Sizing: cap = min(equity x 0.10, dollar_volume20 x 0.01, available cash); shares = int(cap // price), then capped by the risk size int((equity x 0.005) // (2.0 x ATR14)); fewer than 1 share emits nothing.
  - [TRADER_DONCHIAN55] From the algorithm doc's spec section (engine `desk3/aster_batch16.py`): kind "donchian", inputs (bars, positions), cadence_s 86400, session rth, slice capital $10,000 (SLICE = 10000.0). Prints: a UT Bot buy flip through the gate is cyan; an EMA 8/21 cross up within 6 bars of a UT buy flip, through the gate, is green; a UT sell flip is red; an EMA 8/21 cross down within 6 bars of a UT sell flip is magenta. A reclaim with bbPct between 0.35 and 0.92 is an extra buy. A pad sequence buy: not cooled (no buy print in the prior 8 bars), deep pad or washout, not failed euphoria, not above, at least 6 bullish votes, squeeze momentum rising, bbPct between 0.20 and 1.05, and close at or over the open. A support bounce buy: not cooled, not failed euphoria, not an extended failure, at least 5 bullish votes, rel between 0.82 and 1.04, bbPct between 0.20 and 1.05, close at or over the op

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [tr-ro-weekly-cyan-transition] A completed weekly bar with a Tensor 5-of-7 bullish consensus (≥ 5 bullish votes, ≥ 4 more than bearish), bullish votes ≥ bearish + 2, dollar volume ≥ $10M and relative volume 0.8-2. A buy-cyan marker with the close at or above its level 13 weeks back (a compressed base reads as the accumulation instead). Only the bar just completed counts, and the roster's run publishes once at least half its names reach it. Entry: the next week's first open, a market order within that session; skipped once it has passed.
  - [tr-ro-weekly-cyan-transition] Weekly cyan transition: buys a stock on a weekly Tensor buy-cyan with a bullish consensus that is up over the last 13 weeks, and sells at the close of week 20. Type: trend following. Accounting grade PARTIAL (entry, exit and sizing recorded as gaps in the accounting); the card and rule lines in this repo record all three.
- Exit rules:
  - [tr-ro-weekly-cyan-transition] Exit: the close of week 20 (market-on-close when it ends a session).
  - [tr-ro-weekly-cyan-transition] Weekly cyan transition: buys a stock on a weekly Tensor buy-cyan with a bullish consensus that is up over the last 13 weeks, and sells at the close of week 20. Type: trend following. Accounting grade PARTIAL (entry, exit and sizing recorded as gaps in the accounting); the card and rule lines in this repo record all three.
  - [tr-ro-weekly-cyan-transition] - Exit: the close of week 20 (market-on-close when it ends a session).
- Sizing:
  - [tr-ro-weekly-cyan-transition] 6. Sizing: one equal slot per event, the $100,000 book / (1,838 names x 1 timeframe) = about $54; skipped when the book lacks the cash; a modeled cost of 25.5 bp a side.
  - [tr-ro-weekly-cyan-transition] Universe: 1,838-name genome roster. Asset: US equities. Timeframe: 1wk. Book $100,000; slot about $54 per event; modeled cost 25.5 bp a side. Card status: waiting.
- Filters / data:
  - [tr-ro-weekly-cyan-transition] Completed regular-session weekly bars (10 years) of the roster, from Alpaca SIP with keys, else Yahoo; read by the pinned Tensor engine v698 and the vendored research sources.
- Parameters:
  - A completed weekly bar with a Tensor 5-of-7 bullish consensus (≥ 5 bullish votes, ≥ 4 more than bearish), bullish votes ≥ bearish + 2, dollar volume ≥ $10M and relative volume 0.8-2.
  - A buy-cyan marker with the close at or above its level 13 weeks back (a compressed base reads as the accumulation instead).
  - Exit: the close of week 20 (market-on-close when it ends a session).

## QQQ core with a momentum tilt · 150% exposure

- Type: momentum | Family: etf | Style evidence (catalog): not recorded
- Trades: not recorded — not recorded in consulted sources
- Timeframe: not recorded
- Created by / source: not recorded
- Description (from source records): QQQ core with a momentum tilt · 150% exposure
- Algorithm status: **FULL**
- Algorithm sources consulted: ausar_map params/variant, femto land-wt config params, md2 catalog entry/exit/strategy text, Test docs/R19_ETF_CORE25_M150-RECREATE.md

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [R19_ETF_CORE25_M150] ausar variant: QQQ core with a momentum tilt · 150% exposure
  - [ausar_pb84] Ranks the configured ETF basket by its completed 126-session price return; equal scores use alphabetical ticker order. Keeps 75% of the target portfolio in QQQ and 25% in the selected leader. If QQQ leads, the two portions combine into QQQ. Targets ETF holdings worth 150% of the paper account's net value, rounded down to whole shares. The excess uses simulated borrowing.
  - [ausar_r19_R19_ETF_CORE25_M150] Ranks the configured ETF basket by its completed 126-session price return; equal scores use alphabetical ticker order. Keeps 75% of the target portfolio in QQQ and 25% in the selected leader. If QQQ leads, the two portions combine into QQQ. Targets ETF holdings worth 150% of the paper account's net value, rounded down to whole shares. The excess uses simulated borrowing.
- Exit rules:
  - [ausar_pb84] Reduce or replace holdings when the next monthly selection changes their target. This strategy has no price-based stop or profit target.
  - [ausar_r19_R19_ETF_CORE25_M150] Reduce or replace holdings when the next monthly selection changes their target. This strategy has no price-based stop or profit target.
- Sizing:
  - [R19_ETF_CORE25_M150] 5. Targets: whole shares, int(gross x equity x weight / price), where equity is account_value or net_value from extra when present, otherwise the slice capital (default $10,000). A target price at or below zero emits nothing. Gross is applied as coded and never silently capped in the sleeve; for gross above 1 the dispatcher buying-power check governs execution (for the 150% form the accounting adds: "The excess uses simulated borrowing.").
- Filters / data:
  - [ausar_pb84] data: Completed historical ETF bars for signals; separately labeled IEX quotes for execution. The two-source versions compare complete Alpaca and Yahoo histories without joining them.
  - [ausar_r19_R19_ETF_CORE25_M150] data: posted r19 data adapters
- Key parameters (recorded, per alias): {"R19_ETF_CORE25_M150": {"symbols": ["QQQ", "SPY", "SMH", "XLB", "XLC", "XLE", "XLF", "XLI", "XLK", "XLP", "XLRE", "XLU", "XLV", "XLY"]}}

## 52-week-high strength

- Type: momentum | Family: griffith | Style evidence (catalog): 52-week-high momentum
- Trades: US equities — SCOPE universe: 550 US names
- Timeframe: 1d (monthly)

- Algorithm sources consulted: Test catalog entry/variants, Test strategies/griffith/griffith-52w-high-rs.md, dwj9ddyvf6-hub/Test strategies/griffith/griffith-52w-high-rs.md, dwj9ddyvf6-hub/Test (main) strategies/griffith/griffith-52w-high-rs.md — section '## Exit', docs/GRIFFITH_52W_HIGH_RS-RECREATE.md, Test docs/GRIFFITH_52W_HIGH_RS-RECREATE.md (Configuration section), 2026-10-31 algorithm audit cure A (findings b1-entry, b2-exit, b3-sizing, b5-reconcile; quotes verbatim from cited sources)

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [griffith-52w-high-rs] Decision: at the first pass of each month, on the prior month's last SPY bar; the month waits until the tape carries 99% of the names it can. Score: the cutoff close / the highest high of the last 252 sessions, for names with a bar on the cutoff day and 60 sessions of positive volume; at least 10 names. Pick: the top half by 60-day median dollar volume, then its top decile by score (rounded up, at least 1; ties by symbol). Orders: each pick at 1/N of the book and the rest to zero, as marketable limits (1% through the quote, 30 minutes), re-sent on each of the month's first 5 sessions.
- Exit rules:
  - [griffith-52w-high-rs] A name out of the next month's pick is sold at that rebalance; an empty pick is cash.
  - [griffith-52w-high-rs] 6. Exit: a name out of the next month's pick is sold at that rebalance; an empty pick is cash. The lab's own horizon label is 21 sessions; the desk book holds until the next month's rebalance (19-23 sessions), a divergence recorded in the griffith_factor.py module docstring.
  - [griffith-52w-high-rs] - A name out of the next month's pick is sold at that rebalance; an empty pick is cash.
- Sizing:
  - [griffith-52w-high-rs] Book: $100,000, equal weights (card Sizing section).
  - [griffith-52w-high-rs] Frozen lab spec: lookback 252, rebalance MONTH_END, liquidity TOP_HALF_MEDIAN_DOLLAR_VOLUME_60D, selection TOP_DECILE_EQUAL_WEIGHT, horizonSessions 21, state IMPLEMENTED_SHADOW; lab authority string OFFLINE_SHADOW_NO_PROMOTION_NO_RISK_NO_BROKER (the desk book is the forward-test form of the shadow rule).
- Filters / data:
  - [griffith-52w-high-rs] Decision: at the first pass of each month, on the prior month's last SPY bar; the month waits until the tape carries 99% of the names it can. Score: the cutoff close / the highest high of the last 252 sessions, for names with a bar on the cutoff day and 60 sessions of positive volume; at least 10 names. Pick: the top half by 60-day median dollar volume, then its top decile by score (rounded up, at least 1; ties by symbol). Orders: each pick at 1/N of the book and the rest to zero, as marketable limits (1% through the quote, 30 minutes), re-sent on each of the month's first 5 sessions.
- Parameters:
  - SleeveConfig in griffith_factor.py: family griffith_factor, cadence_s 300, schedule rth, universe = the SCOPE tape symbols, params {version_id: HIGH52_MONTHLY_1_0_0, cost_bps: 10.0, selection: "top decile, top half by liquidity"}, state_schema {month, targets}.

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [griffith-etf-tsmom12] Decision: at the first pass of each month, on the prior month's last SPY bar; the month waits until the tape carries 99% of the names it can. Basket: SPY, QQQ, IWM, DIA, XLF, XLK, XLE, XLI, XLP, XLV, XLU, TLT and GLD (the frozen 17 less XLY, XLB, XLRE and IEF, which the tape never carries); each needs a bar on the cutoff day. Long when the cutoff close is above the close 252 sessions before (253 bars needed). Orders: each pick at 1/N of the book and the rest to zero, as marketable limits (1% through the quote, 30 minutes), re-sent on each of the month's first 5 sessions.
  - [griffith-etf-tsmom12] A monthly, long-or-cash, equal-weight ETF time-series momentum book. Once a month it looks at each ETF in a frozen 17-name basket (13 of which the tape actually carries), keeps every ETF whose 252-session (12-month) return is positive, weights the survivors equally, and holds cash for the rest. There is no short side and no leverage in the record.
- Exit rules:
  - [griffith-etf-tsmom12] A name out of the next month's pick is sold at that rebalance; an empty pick is cash.
  - [griffith-etf-tsmom12] 6. Exit: a name out of the next month's pick is sold at that rebalance; an empty pick is cash. There is no intra-month stop or target in the record.
  - [griffith-etf-tsmom12] - A name out of the next month's pick is sold at that rebalance; an empty pick is cash.
- Sizing:
  - [griffith-etf-tsmom12] Book size on the card: $100,000, equal weights.
- Filters / data:
  - [griffith-etf-tsmom12] 3. Per-ETF signal (evaluate_etf_candidate, version ETF_TSMOM_12M_1_0_0): the symbol must be in the frozen basket (else INELIGIBLE); bars are taken at or before the cutoff and the last bar's date must equal the cutoff date (else UNAVAILABLE, cutoff bar required); at least 253 bars are required; the metric is return252 = close[-1] / close[-253] - 1 (the 252-session return); status is SETUP when return252 > 0, otherwise WAIT. The lab spec records: family ETF_TIME_SERIES_MOMENTUM, lookback 252, rule LONG_IF_252_SESSION_RETURN_POSITIVE_ELSE_CASH, rebalance MONTH_END, horizonSessions 21, state IMPLEMENTED_SHADOW.

  - Constants in the code: COVERAGE 0.99, RETRY_SESSIONS 5, ONE_WAY_BPS 10.0, HORIZON 20 (the daily-book observation horizon in the same module; the monthly lab spec's horizonSessions is 21).

  - [mn-tsmom-12-1-etf] 5. Study scope note from the card: the recorder read seven momentum forms on this panel; the study trades only its primary 12-1 form on it, so the row is converted as that book (the long/short etf-12-1-ls form in the study is not this book).
- Exit rules:
  - [mn-tsmom-12-1-etf] A held name whose sign is no longer positive goes to cash at that rebalance (market-on-close); the weights drift in between; no stop.
  - [mn-tsmom-12-1-etf] From the strategy card and the TypeScript source (sign12 in src/lib/research/tsmom.ts; the etf-12-1-flat book in scripts/tsmom-forms.ts), in evaluation order:
  - [mn-tsmom-12-1-etf] - A held name whose sign is no longer positive goes to cash at that rebalance (market-on-close); the weights drift in between; no stop.
- Sizing:
  - [mn-tsmom-12-1-etf] 4. Sizing: 1 / N of the book per long name (N = number of positive-sign names at the rebalance); $100,000 book.
  - [mn-tsmom-12-1-etf] Book $100,000; rebalance every 21 sessions; lookback 252 sessions with 21-session skip; minimum 260 valid sessions; universe 30 diversified ETFs; equal weights 1/N over positive-sign names; market-on-close orders in the last 40 to 15 minutes of the rebalance session; no stop.
- Filters / data:

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [ausar_r19_R19_TIMING_OVERNIGHT_5BP] Compares the current 13:00-to-15:00 return with the historical 80th percentile over up to 252 full sessions, requiring at least 126. Early-close days are excluded.
- Exit rules:
  - [ausar_r19_R19_TIMING_OVERNIGHT_5BP] 1. Exits first; if any exit is emitted the evaluation returns with no entry. Quantity floors to whole units in the sleeve engine (corrected; see correction line in this sizing field); if qty <= 0, no entry.
  - [R19_ADAUSDT_ABSORPTION_BASE_FIXED16_VOLUME1PCT] Sizing: fullcash quantity equals the engine formula on slice cash; volume1pct quantity never exceeds 1% of the shock bar's volume.

## Opening gamma puts

- Type: mean reversion | Family: ausar | Style evidence (catalog): Opening reversal
- Trades: Equity options — 42-name R5 list
- Timeframe: 5m
- Created by / source: Ausar R18 opening-reversal research (R5 events)
- Description (from source records): Opening gamma puts
- Algorithm status: **FULL**
- Algorithm sources consulted: Test catalog entry/variants, muse-desk-v3 roster params/slice, Test strategies/ausar/opt-opening-gamma.md, docs/ASTER_OPEN_GAMMA_A-RECREATE.md, dwj9ddyvf6-hub/Test strategies/ausar/opt-opening-gamma.md, dwj9ddyvf6-hub/Test (main) strategies/ausar/opt-opening-gamma.md — section '## Exit', Test docs/ASTER_OPEN_GAMMA_A-RECREATE.md (Configuration section), 2026-10-31 algorithm audit cure A (findings b1-entry, b2-exit, b3-sizing, b5-reconcile; quotes verbatim from cited sources)

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [opt-opening-gamma] Prior afternoon: the last-two-hours return ≥ the 80th percentile of its trailing 252 sessions (at least 126). Today: the first 5-minute bar closes down and price breaks below its low; buys 09:35-09:45 ET. Puts, delta 0.50-0.65: A 0-2 DTE, B 7-14 DTE.
  - [opt-opening-gamma] 3. Entry window: 09:35 <= ET < 09:45 only, and only with the opening-event clock causality checks in the engine passing.
- Exit rules:
  - [opt-opening-gamma] Sells at 10:00 ET the same day.
  - [opt-opening-gamma] 6. Exit: flat at 10:00 ET on the entry day (or later if that exit is missed; an expiry obligation can force an earlier exit). No other exit, stop, or target.
  - [opt-opening-gamma] - Sells at 10:00 ET the same day.
- Sizing:
  - [aster_open_gamma_a] v3 slice: {"capital_usd": 10000.0, "cash_usd": 10000.0} parked=False
  - [aster_open_gamma_b] v3 slice: {"capital_usd": 10000.0, "cash_usd": 10000.0} parked=False
- Filters / data:
  - [opt-opening-gamma] Prior afternoon: the last-two-hours return ≥ the 80th percentile of its trailing 252 sessions (at least 126). Today: the first 5-minute bar closes down and price breaks below its low; buys 09:35-09:45 ET. Puts, delta 0.50-0.65: A 0-2 DTE, B 7-14 DTE.
- Parameters:
  - Structure: long puts, delta 0.50-0.65, DTE (0, 2). Risk fraction 0.02 of the slice; premium cap 0.025 of spot.
  - Cadence: cadence_s 300. Session: rth. bp_buffer_frac 0.02. flat_by_close false; flatten_time_et null. params: {}.
- Variant axes (catalog): [{"Book": "A", "DTE": "0-2", "Risk": "2%"}, {"Book": "B", "DTE": "7-14", "Risk": "0.5%"}, {"Book": "A", "DTE": "0-2", "Risk": "2%"}, {"Book": "B", "DTE": "7-14", "Risk": "0.5%"}, {"Book": "A", "DTE": "0-2", "Risk": "2%"}, {"Book": "B", "DTE": "7-14", "Risk": "0.5%"}, {"Book": "A", "DTE": "0-2", "Risk": "2%"}, {"Book": "B", "DTE": "7-14", "Risk": "0.5%"}]

## R19 10-minute EMA cloud reclaim

- Type: mean reversion | Family: ausar | Style evidence (catalog): Intraday pullback
- Trades: US equities — Frozen 42-name list
- Timeframe: 10m (1h bias)
- Created by / source: Ausar R17 intraday geometry research
- Description (from source records): R19 10-minute EMA cloud reclaim
- Algorithm status: **FULL**
- Algorithm sources consulted: Test catalog entry/variants, md2 catalog entry/exit/strategy text, muse-desk-v3 roster params/slice, dwj9ddyvf6-hub/Test (main) strategies/ausar/r19-timing-cloud.md — section '## Exit', docs/ASTER_R19_TIMING_CLOUD_AGGRESSIVE-RECREATE.md, Test docs/ASTER_R19_TIMING_CLOUD_AGGRESSIVE-RECREATE.md (Configuration section), 2026-10-31 algorithm audit cure A (findings b1-entry, b2-exit, b3-sizing, b5-reconcile; quotes verbatim from cited sources)

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [ausar_r19_R19_TIMING_CLOUD_AGGRESSIVE] Requires an hourly EMA34 > EMA50 trend, then the first ten-minute EMA5/EMA12 cloud touch and causal reclaim. Rejects broken cloud episodes and repeated reclaims.
  - [ausar_r19_R19_TIMING_CLOUD_BASE] Requires an hourly EMA34 > EMA50 trend, then the first ten-minute EMA5/EMA12 cloud touch and causal reclaim. Rejects broken cloud episodes and repeated reclaims.
- Exit rules:
  - [r19-timing-cloud] Stop at the dip's low - 0.1 ATR; target the prior session high; time exit after 100 minutes, by 15:50 ET at the latest.
  - [r19-timing-cloud] Exit evaluation in desk3/aster_batch15.py::_eval_timing, before entries, for every non-zero position: bid is the sell quote, else the last close of the kind's timeframe. In order: if stop is set and bid <= stop, exit reason `observed_stop_trigger`; else if target is set and bid >= target, exit reason `observed_target`; else if exit_at is set and now >= exit_at, exit reason `scheduled_time_exit`; else (hourly only) if 20 native bars have ended after the position's signal_end, exit reason `original_20_native_bar_deadline`. Any exit suppresses entries that cycle. Exit intents are market day sell_to_close unless a sleeve-specific rule below state
  - [r19-timing-cloud] - Stop at the dip's low - 0.1 ATR; target the prior session high; time exit after 100 minutes, by 15:50 ET at the latest.
- Sizing:
  - [aster_r19_timing_cloud_aggressive] v3 slice: {"capital_usd": 10000.0, "cash_usd": 10000.0} parked=False
  - [aster_r19_timing_cloud_base] v3 slice: {"capital_usd": 10000.0, "cash_usd": 10000.0} parked=False
- Filters / data:
  - [ausar_r19_R19_TIMING_CLOUD_AGGRESSIVE] data: posted r19 data adapters
  - [ausar_r19_R19_TIMING_CLOUD_BASE] data: posted r19 data adapters
- Parameters:
  - Sizing / slice: capital_usd 10000.0, cash_usd 10000.0; bp_buffer_frac=0.02; per-sleeve notional, risk, fee and slots are in the Full algorithm section.
- Variant axes (catalog): [{"Book": "CLOUD_BASE", "Risk": "0.25%", "Notional": "10%"}, {"Book": "CLOUD_AGGRESSIVE", "Risk": "0.5%", "Notional": "20%"}, {"Book": "CLOUD_BASE", "Risk": "0.25%", "Notional": "10%"}, {"Book": "CLOUD_AGGRESSIVE", "Risk": "0.5%", "Notional": "20%"}, {"Book": "CLOUD_BASE", "Risk": "0.25%", "Notional": "10%"}, {"Book": "CLOUD_AGGRESSIVE", "Risk": "0.5%", "Notional": "20%"}, {"Book": "CLOUD_BASE", "Risk": "0.25%", "Notional": "10%"}, {"Book": "CLOUD_AGGRESSIVE", "Risk": "0.5%", "Notional": "20%"}]

- Timeframe: 1d · 1h

- Description (from source records): RSI(2) pullback

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [ausar_pb46] On completed hourly bars within the configured UTC date window, enter long when Wilder RSI2 < 10, close > SMA200 and SMA4(RSI2) < 30. Exit when close > SMA5, the average of the five most recent hourly closes. The configured stop is disabled; no short entry is permitted.
  - [fwd_alpaca_ada_rsi2] sleeve-owned (sleeves/fwd_alpaca_ada_rsi2.py)
  - [rsi_meanrev] sleeve-owned (sleeves/rsi_meanrev.py)
- Exit rules:
  - [ausar_pb46] Sell when a completed hourly close rises above the moving average of the five most recent hourly closes. This configuration disables the price stop.
  - [fwd_alpaca_ada_rsi2] sleeve-owned exit intents
  - [rsi_meanrev] sleeve-owned exit intents
- Sizing:
  - [aster_pub_rsi2_ada] v3 slice: {"capital_usd": 10000.0, "cash_usd": 10000.0} parked=False
  - [aster_rsi2_1d] v3 slice: {"capital_usd": 10000.0, "cash_usd": 10000.0} parked=False

- Type: mean reversion | Family: milkman | Style evidence (catalog): Oscillator reversal

- Algorithm status: **FULL**
- Algorithm sources consulted: Test catalog entry/variants, Test strategies/milkman/mk-fourhourpoopexrollover.md, docs/MK_FOURHOURPOOPEXROLLOVER-RECREATE.md, dwj9ddyvf6-hub/Test strategies/milkman/mk-fourhourpoopexrollover.md, dwj9ddyvf6-hub/Test (main) strategies/milkman/mk-fourhourpoopexrollover.md — section '## Exit', Test strategies/milkman/mk-fourhourpoopexrollover.md (Sizing section), Test docs/verify/milkman.md, Test docs/MK_FOURHOURPOOPEXROLLOVER-RECREATE.md (Full algorithm section), Test docs/MK_FOURHOURPOOPEXROLLOVER-RECREATE.md (Configuration section), 2026-10-31 algorithm audit cure A (findings b1-entry, b2-exit, b3-sizing, b5-reconcile; quotes verbatim from cited sources)

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [mk-fourhourpoopexrollover] A 4-hour candle's Phase Oscillator under 80 after one at ≥ 80, the first per day, on the session on or after the third Friday or the 5 after it. ### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [mk-legendsbuyday] Overnight leg: after exactly 3 lower closes in a row, buys at the close (short lane: after exactly 3 higher closes, shorts). Stocks trade only while their 20-day mean dollar volume is ≥ $5M and the close ≥ $3. Day leg (SPY, long only): after exactly 4 sessions that each made a lower low than the one before (the one before them did not), buys the next open if it is under the prior close + 0.15 × ATR (the mean of the last 20 daily ranges) and above the stop.
  - [mk-legendsbuyday] Legend's Buy Day: one sleeve of the Milkman v2 study's rule set as installed on the master desk in this repo. The card summary and the full rule follow.
- Exit rules:
  - [mk-legendsbuyday] Overnight leg: sold at the next open. - Day leg: stop one cent under the prior day's low; otherwise sold at that session's close.
  - [mk-legendsbuyday] Engine phases (sleeves/milkman/daily.py header): watch (open to close-16: open phase, then touch phase on the session range so far), close (close-15 to close-11: touch phase, then close phase on the provisional bar), after (completed bar: missed touches, close phase not taken late, end phase; its events execute next open). Bars missed while the desk was down are replayed for state; their entries are not taken late and their exits execute at the next open.
  - [mk-legendsbuyday] - Overnight leg: sold at the next open. - Day leg: stop one cent under the prior day's low; otherwise sold at that session's close.
- Sizing:
  - [mk-legendsbuyday] $10,000 a trade on a $1,000,000 book, every signal taken; each lane keeps its own trades and the sleeve trades the net per symbol.

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [muse-przm-fade-edges] Gamma (recreated): per strike GEX = open interest x gamma x 100 x spot, calls positive and puts negative. Magnet: strike of largest absolute net GEX. Flip: strike where cumulative net GEX changes sign. Regime (extracted test): pin when spot is above the flip; run otherwise. No substitute regime test is permitted by the spec. In a pin: SPY within 0.05% of the session high with that high above the magnet enters short toward the magnet; mirrored at the low. One fade per edge per session, at most two open; entries 09:45 to 15:15 ET, edges first fadeable at 10:00 ET.
  - [muse-przm-fade-edges] Entries, only when regime is pin: gates in order are entry time in 09:45 to 15:15 ET, time at or after 10:00 ET (edges_not_printable_before_1000), and equity > 0. Session high = maximum high and low = minimum low of today's bars. Short fade when spot >= hi * (1 - 0.0005), hi > magnet and the high edge was not already faded today; long fade when spot <= lo * (1 + 0.0005), lo < magnet and the low edge was not already faded. An edge already past the magnet is spent: no trade. Otherwise state pin_no_edge_touch. On an entry: qty = max(1, int(2000 // spot)), stop = round(edge * 1.0015, 4) for a short / round(edge * 0.9985, 4) for a long, target = m
- Exit rules:
  - [muse-przm-fade-edges] Target: the magnet. Invalidation: a 1-minute close 0.15% beyond the faded edge. A regime flip to run exits at once. Flat at 15:45 ET.
  - [muse-przm-fade-edges] Entries, only when regime is pin: gates in order are entry time in 09:45 to 15:15 ET, time at or after 10:00 ET (edges_not_printable_before_1000), and equity > 0. Session high = maximum high and low = minimum low of today's bars. Short fade when spot >= hi * (1 - 0.0005), hi > magnet and the high edge was not already faded today; long fade when spot <= lo * (1 + 0.0005), lo < magnet and the low edge was not already faded. An edge already past the magnet is spent: no trade. Otherwise state pin_no_edge_touch. On an entry: qty = max(1, int(2000 // spot)), stop = round(edge * 1.0015, 4) for a short / round(edge * 0.9985, 4) for a long, target = m
  - [muse-przm-fade-edges] - Target: the magnet. Invalidation: a 1-minute close 0.15% beyond the faded edge. A regime flip to run exits at once. Flat at 15:45 ET.
- Sizing:
  - [przm_fade_edges] v3 slice: {"capital_usd": 10000.0, "cash_usd": 10000.0} parked=True
- Filters / data:
  - [muse-przm-fade-edges] Inputs are bars / bars_1min / bars:SPY:1Min (SPY 1-minute bars for today, RTH, with o/h/l/c), options and options_chain, positions, quotes and session_fills. The strategy consumes bars[SPY], ctx.now, ctx.session, ctx.equity, the held SPY quantity in slice_state, ctx.extra przm_fade_state (faded_edges, plan, regime_log round-tripped by the adapter) and ctx.extra przm_chain (chain rows with strike, gamma, open interest / oi and right / type). Chain rows lacking gamma or open interest produce the WAITING_NO_GAMMA_LEVELS state above, by design.

## Shen first-touch fade (SPY 0DTE)

- Type: mean reversion | Family: muse | Style evidence (catalog): Level fade
- Trades: SPY options (0DTE) — SPY
- Timeframe: 1m
- Created by / source: Shen Lao (@shentrades), his 10-step SPY 0DTE playbook
- Description (from source records): Shen first-touch fade (SPY 0DTE)
- Algorithm status: **FULL**
- Algorithm sources consulted: Test catalog entry/variants, md2 catalog entry/exit/strategy text, Test strategies/muse/muse-shen-fade.md, docs/MUSE_SHEN_FADE-RECREATE.md, dwj9ddyvf6-hub/Test strategies/muse/muse-shen-fade.md, dwj9ddyvf6-hub/Test (main) strategies/muse/muse-shen-fade.md — section '## Exit', Test docs/MUSE_SHEN_FADE-RECREATE.md (Configuration section), Test packages/claude/master-desk-sleeve-port-library/desk/sleeves/muse/sleeves/shen_fade.py, 2026-10-31 algorithm audit cure A (findings b1-entry, b2-exit, b3-sizing, b5-reconcile; quotes verbatim from cited sources)

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [muse-shen-fade] Levels, fixed at 09:29:30: the prior session's high and low, today's premarket high and low, and the three whole dollars nearest the last premarket close; levels within $0.10 merge. Bias from that reference: above the prior high only puts, below the prior low only calls, otherwise both. First touch only: the first completed 1-minute bar reaching a level's ±$0.10 zone burns it; RSI(14) on that bar's close above 70 buys puts, below 30 calls, otherwise nothing. Contract: today's SPY expiry, strike nearest the touch bar's close, its quote two-sided, spread ≤ 5% of mid, ≤ 60 s old. Order: a limit at the mid, at the ask from 60 seconds, cancelled at 180 seconds or once price leaves the zone or RSI
  - [muse-shen-fade] 6. Entry order ladder: a limit at the mid, at the ask from 60 seconds (the ladder's middle step, mid plus half the spread, is the ask), cancelled at 180 seconds or once price leaves the zone or RSI leaves its extreme. Entries 09:30-11:10, one position at a time. Never a market entry order. On the master desk a re-priced entry for the same contract and size counts as the working order.
- Exit rules:
  - [muse-shen-fade] Take profit: a resting limit at 1.20 × the premium paid; stop: the first pass with the option's mid at or under 0.85 ×, sold at the mid. - Flat at 11:15: a mid limit, then the bid, then market at 11:17. - New entries end for the day once realized P&L reaches -1.80% or +2.40% of the slice.
  - [muse-shen-fade] 7. Bracket on the fill: take-profit resting limit at 1.20 x the premium paid; stop at the first pass with the option's mid at or under 0.85 x the premium paid, sold at the mid.
  - [muse-shen-fade] - Take profit: a resting limit at 1.20 × the premium paid; stop: the first pass with the option's mid at or under 0.85 ×, sold at the mid. - Flat at 11:15: a mid limit, then the bid, then market at 11:17. - New entries end for the day once realized P&L reaches -1.80% or +2.40% of the slice.
- Sizing:
  - [muse-shen-fade] Slice: $10,000; sizing 4% of the slice in premium per trade, whole contracts, at least 1; the master desk sends no entry costing more than the slice's free cash.
- Filters / data:
  - [muse-shen-fade] SPY 1-minute bars (2,400: the prior session, the premarket and today; SIP bars per the code header), today's SPY option chain with quotes, and the sleeve's own fills.
- Parameters:
  - RSI_PERIOD = 14 # R-1: RSI(14) Wilder, 1-min closes
  - ZONE_HALF = 0.10 # R-6: +/- $0.10 zone, both jobs
  - WHOLE_COUNT = 3 # R-4: exactly 3 whole dollars

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [sable-location-first] Funnel: every stock's 6 months of daily closes; the 48 best under-50-day reads and the 48 best leaders-rest reads (plus SPY, QQQ) are re-read on 400 days of daily OHLC with today's forming bar and the live price. Out: price above the 50-day EMA, RSI(14) > 52, the 50-day EMA down > 1.5% over 10 sessions, under $3 with < $2M 20-day dollar volume, or earnings from 12 h before to 48 h ahead. Shelf: the 21-day EMA within 2%, the 12-day low within 4%, or a 50 / 61.8 / 78.6% retrace of the 60-day swing within 2.5%; the best by weight, confluence and distance; price ≤ 3% above it. Repair: RSI 28-52; the ATR-scaled MACD(12, 26, 9) histogram up in 2 of the last 3 sessions with a net lift; ≥ 8% under t
  - [sable-location-first] 7. Orders per the card: marketable limits (1% through the quote), good for an hour; a working buy is cancelled once its name leaves the hands. (The code header records the desk-engine divergence that the pass's buys become marketable engine orders decided on the same simulated state.)
- Exit rules:
  - [sable-location-first] Stop at fill - 1.6 × ATR, target at fill + 2.8 × ATR (daily ATR(14), at least 1.5% of the fill; both widen if ATR grows), checked on the quote every 5 minutes. - Time stop: after 15 days if the position is not in profit.
  - [sable-location-first] 9. Exits, checked on the quote every 5 minutes: stop at fill - 1.6 x ATR, target at fill + 2.8 x ATR (daily ATR(14), at least 1.5% of the fill; both widen if ATR grows). Breakeven at +1R: once the stop is moved to the entry price it stays there (card note: the owner's decision Q44, 2026-10-26).
  - [sable-location-first] - Stop at fill - 1.6 × ATR, target at fill + 2.8 × ATR (daily ATR(14), at least 1.5% of the fill; both widen if ATR grows), checked on the quote every 5 minutes. - Time stop: after 15 days if the position is not in profit.
- Sizing:
  - [sable-location-first] 8. Sizing: min(0.5% of equity / (1.6 x ATR), 15% of equity, 98% of cash) in whole shares; a $100,000 book.
- Filters / data:
  - [sable-location-first] Yahoo spark daily closes (6 months); split-adjusted daily bars (400 days) with today's forming bar; live quotes; the Nasdaq earnings calendar.
- Parameters:
  - DEEP_OHLC_CAP = 48
  - DESK_BUY_TIERS = ("S", "A", "B")
  - DESK_BUY_ACTIONS = ("SETUP", "WATCH")

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [sable-support-scanner] Deep list: held names, the last scan's buy-side names, SPY / QQQ / IWM, then the best spark screen scores (near the 52-week or day low, down on the day) up to 36 names. Each gets a quote from the last 5 sessions' completed regular-hours 5-minute bars: support = the 64-bar low, ATR(14), RSI(14), the 12 / 26 EMA gap, VWAP; with the spark's 52-week range. Buy: a SETUP with price ≥ 99.5% of support and ≤ 1.6 ATR above it, RSI 38-68, EMA gap ≥ -0.15, below 88% of the 52-week range; stocks only. Hands: the first 6 buy-side rows, SETUPs first by score (improving momentum, a tight range, volume and the lowest 30% of the 52-week range add points). Buys each SETUP hand not held, not sold in the last 8
  - [sable-support-scanner] 5. Entry execution: buy each SETUP hand not held, not sold in the last 8 hours, while under 6 positions (working buys count), in the regular session; free slots fill in the catalog's order. Orders: marketable limits (1% through the quote), good for an hour; a working buy is cancelled once its name leaves the hands.
- Exit rules:
  - [sable-support-scanner] Stop at fill - 1.6 × ATR, target at fill + 2.8 × ATR (5-minute ATR(14), at least 1.5% of the fill: -2.4% / +4.2% at that floor), checked every 5 minutes. - Time stop: after 15 days if the position is not in profit.
  - [sable-support-scanner] 6. Exit, checked every 5 minutes: stop at fill - 1.6 x ATR, target at fill + 2.8 x ATR (5-minute ATR(14), at least 1.5% of the fill: -2.4% / +4.2% at that floor). Breakeven at +1R: once the stop is moved to the entry price, it stays there.
  - [sable-support-scanner] - Stop at fill - 1.6 × ATR, target at fill + 2.8 × ATR (5-minute ATR(14), at least 1.5% of the fill: -2.4% / +4.2% at that floor), checked every 5 minutes. - Time stop: after 15 days if the position is not in profit.
- Sizing:
  - [sable-support-scanner] Book: $100,000 (per card sizing). Max positions: 6. Deep list cap: 36 names.
- Filters / data:
  - [sable-support-scanner] 8. Notes recorded on the card: no earnings filter (the 5-minute quotes carry no earnings flag); Tensor reads are not supplied, so the source's Tensor SELL veto and score badges are off.
- Parameters:
  - Deep list: held names, the last scan's buy-side names, SPY / QQQ / IWM, then the best spark screen scores (near the 52-week or day low, down on the day) up to 36 names.
  - Each gets a quote from the last 5 sessions' completed regular-hours 5-minute bars: support = the 64-bar low, ATR(14), RSI(14), the 12 / 26 EMA gap, VWAP; with the spark's 52-week range.

- Signal / entry rules:

Side: the underdog, the lower Gamma price at a pregame read ≤ 2 h before the start, else the lower first post-start print; no side 30 minutes in skips the match. Profile (PZOE), chosen once at the first print: from older matches only, the first group with ≥ 30 priors (sport + cohort + opening bucket, sport + cohort, cohort + bucket, sport, cohort, all; buckets < 20c, 20-40c, 40-60c, ≥ 60c); each of 14 frozen profiles is replayed on it.   - [span-harvest] Buys an in-play Polymarket underdog on a deep dip below its opening price with a three-rung ladder, then harvests, trails or settles three inventory slices (A 34%, B 33%, C 33%).
- Exit rules:
  - [span-harvest] Inventory: A 34%, B 33%, C 33% of the shares bought. - A: sold at ceil(max(2.15 × average fill, average + 18c)). - B: sold at ≥ max(72c, average + 0.5c), or after giving back 38% of the run-up with the 6-minute slope ≤ 0.002. - C: rides; moves to B when the winner-state score (price, slope, recovery) ≤ 0.28. - Salvage at ≤ 8c while falling; flatten 240 minutes after the start (180 for the fast-flatten profile). - What is left settles on the resolution (read every 10 minutes from 1 h after the start): $1 won, the tape cut at the first 3 prints ≥ 99.9c; 0.1c lost. An unknown end stays unresolved; tracking stops after 3 days. - Exits sell at the live bid: a limit at 0.1c, 1-hour window.

## Public Donchian 55 trend (daily)

- Type: breakout | Family: ausar | Style evidence (catalog): Trend breakout
- Trades: US ETFs — 15 liquid ETFs (as RSI2)
- Timeframe: 1d
- Created by / source: trader.dev public strategy; StockCharts price channels
- Description (from source records): Public Donchian 55 trend (daily)
- Algorithm status: **FULL**
- Algorithm sources consulted: Test catalog entry/variants, muse-desk-v3 roster params/slice, Test docs/ASTER_TRADER_DONCHIAN55-ALGORITHM.md, dwj9ddyvf6-hub/Test docs/ASTER_TRADER_DONCHIAN55-ALGORITHM.md, dwj9ddyvf6-hub/Test (main) docs/ASTER_TRADER_DONCHIAN55-ALGORITHM.md — section '## Exit rules', docs/ASTER_TRADER_DONCHIAN55-RECREATE.md, Test docs/ASTER_TRADER_DONCHIAN55-RECREATE.md (Configuration section), Test docs/ASTER_TRADER_DONCHIAN55-ALGORITHM.md (Spec section), 2026-10-31 algorithm audit cure A (findings b1-entry, b2-exit, b3-sizing, b5-reconcile; quotes verbatim from cited sources)

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [public-donchian55] Exits are evaluated first; if any exit is emitted the evaluation returns with no entry. A candidate needs at least 252 daily bars, a positive ATR14 and a positive 20-day average dollar volume. Entry condition: last close above the prior 55-day high (the maximum high of the 55 bars before the last bar) and last close above the 200-day SMA. Candidates are ranked by (close - prior55_high) / ATR14 descending, symbol ascending on ties. Sizing: cap = min(equity x 0.10, dollar_volume20 x 0.01, available cash); shares = int(cap // price), then capped by the risk size int((equity x 0.005) // (2.0 x ATR14)); fewer than 1 share emits nothing. The entry intent is market, day, buy_to_open, with stop_pric
- Exit rules:
  - [public-donchian55] Initial stop: a held position whose last close is at or below its recorded stop_price (the entry 2xATR14 stop, read from the position or its meta) is sold in full. - Timeout: a position held at least 126 completed holding bars is sold in full, reason 126_completed_holding_bars. - Signal exits (with at least 252 bars): a last close below the prior 20-day low and/or below the 200-day SMA sells the position in full, with the triggered conditions named in the reason. - Exits are market, day, sell_to_close intents, in full.
  - [public-donchian55] - Initial stop: a held position whose last close is at or below its recorded stop_price (the entry 2xATR14 stop, read from the position or its meta) is sold in full. - Timeout: a position held at least 126 completed holding bars is sold in full, reason 126_completed_holding_bars. - Signal exits (with at least 252 bars): a last close below the prior 20-day low and/or below the 200-day SMA sells the position in full, with the triggered conditions named in the reason. - Exits are market, day, sell_to_close intents, in full.

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [ausar_r19_R19_ENJUSDT_BREAKOUT_BASE_FIXED16_VOLUME1PCT] A completed four-hour close must exceed the highest high of the prior 20 bars. This control does not require funding.
- Exit rules:
  - [ausar_r19_R19_ENJUSDT_BREAKOUT_BASE_FIXED16_VOLUME1PCT] Master-desk design (Test card `strategies/ausar/r19-crypto-breakout.md`): a completed UTC 4h close above the highest high of the prior 20 bars; buys 4 h after the signal bar closes, inside a 5-minute window, on a fresh quote (spread <= 100 bps, last trade <= 60 s old); long only, one position per book, only signals after the book's activation; fixed16 sells 16 h after the entry time; no stop; fullcash = all book cash at the ask net of the 10 bps fee; volume1pct = capped at 1% of the volume of the 4h bar that completes at entry; floored to the venue lot. The card notes the v3 translation differs: it buys at the signal bar's close when it evaluates, its deadlines count from the fill, and volum
- Sizing:
  - [ausar_r19_R19_ENJUSDT_BREAKOUT_BASE_FIXED16_VOLUME1PCT] 4. Sizing: price = latest bar close; qty = slice cash / (price x (1 + 0.001 fee)); for volume1pct, qty = min(qty, 1% of the preceding 4h bar's volume, `brs[-2]`); qty <= 0 is no entry; quantity rounded to 8 decimals.
  - [ausar_r19_R19_ENJUSDT_BREAKOUT_BASE_FIXED16_VOLUME1PCT] Cadence: 300 s (engine config_rows cadence for batch 7). Slice cash default in the engines: $10,000 when no slice cash is supplied (engine text).
- Filters / data:
  - [ausar_r19_R19_ENJUSDT_BREAKOUT_BASE_FIXED16_VOLUME1PCT] data: posted r19 data adapters
- Parameters:
  - Symbol: ENJUSDT. Timeframe: 4h (native UTC bars). Family: breakout_base. Exit: fixed16, hold 16 h.
  - Capacity: volume1pct. Fee: 10 bps each side (accounting parameters where recorded; engine FEE = 0.001).

## CCI correction pullback

- Type: breakout | Family: galath | Style evidence (catalog): Trend pullback
- Trades: US equities — 1,838-name genome
- Timeframe: 1d
- Created by / source: GrokBot, from an X post's Lowest(CCI(27), 18) < -100 filter
- Description (from source records): CCI correction pullback CCI correction pullback (Lowest(CCI27,18)<-100, @onlybreakouts)
- Algorithm status: **FULL**
- Algorithm sources consulted: Test catalog entry/variants, md2 catalog entry/exit/strategy text, muse-desk-v3 roster params/slice, Test strategies/galath/galath-cci-correction.md, dwj9ddyvf6-hub/Test strategies/galath/galath-cci-correction.md, dwj9ddyvf6-hub/Test (main) strategies/galath/galath-cci-correction.md — section '## Exit', docs/T_CCI_CORR-RECREATE.md, Test docs/T_CCI_CORR-RECREATE.md (Configuration section), Test docs/T_CCI_CORR-ALGORITHM.md (Spec section), 2026-10-31 algorithm audit cure A (findings b1-entry, b2-exit, b3-sizing, b5-reconcile; quotes verbatim from cited sources)

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [galath-cci-correction] Close ≥ $5 and 20-day average dollar volume ≥ $20M; close above the 200-day SMA and the 50-day above the 200-day. Regime: SPY above its 200-day SMA and VIX under 30. Correction: the lowest CCI(27) of the last 18 sessions < -100. Trigger: CCI crosses back above -100, or the close tops the prior high while CCI rises and is still below 0. Decided pre-market (from 07:00 ET) on the completed session; bought 09:30-09:35 ET with marketable orders, lowest CCI first, up to 10 positions.
- Exit rules:
  - [galath-cci-correction] Stop 2 × ATR(14) under the fill, target the fill + 3R (6 ATR), engine-held. - Trail: the highest close since entry - 3 ATR, ratcheting up only. - A close below the 200-day SMA sells at the next open. - Time stop: 20 sessions counting the entry session.
  - [galath-cci-correction] 2. Position management on each new completed bar per held symbol, in bar order: bars_held increments, hi_close tracks the highest close, and the trailing stop ratchets up only to max(stop, hi_close - 3 times ATR at that bar). Exits are then checked on closes, in this order: close at or below the (trailed) stop (stop_on_close); close at or above the target (target_on_close); close below SMA200 at that bar (close_below_sma200); bars_held at least 20 (time_exit_20_bars). An exit is a full-qty sell_to_close Intent at that bar's close, reason naming the exit kind, bars held and the stop, and the record is marked exiting so it fires once.
  - [galath-cci-correction] - Stop 2 × ATR(14) under the fill, target the fill + 3R (6 ATR), engine-held. - Trail: the highest close since entry - 3 ATR, ratcheting up only. - A close below the 200-day SMA sells at the next open. - Time stop: 20 sessions counting the entry session.
- Sizing:
  - [t_cci_corr] v3 slice: {"capital_usd": 1000.0, "cash_usd": 1000.0} parked=False
- Filters / data:
  - [galath-cci-correction] Inputs are daily bars for the screening universe and SPY, the bars:VIX:1Day regime series (also carried as vix_rows in ctx.extra by the adapter), positions and session_fills. Each symbol needs at least 218 completed daily bars for a signal (SMA200 plus lookback slack), SPY needs at least 200 for the regime SMA, and VIX must have a close on or before the signal date. Freshness: only completed bars before the current session date are used, and the entry scan runs once per new completed SPY bar date. Missing regime evidence fails closed: no entries.
- Parameters:
  - Module adapters3.t_cci_corr; cadence_s 300; session rth; slice capital_usd 1000.0, cash_usd 1000.0; bp_buffer_frac 0.02; flat_by_close false; flatten_time_et null; timeout_s null; params {}; inputs [bars, bars:VIX:1Day, vix, positions, session_fills]; parked false. Universe: the screening universe carried in the bars payload (every symbol key except SPY is scanned; SPY is the regime series), daily bars; the existing repo card states a 1,838-name genome universe and 1d timeframe. Source: muse-des
  - - Setup: the lowest CCI(27) reading over the last 18 sessions falls below -100, while the regime filter shows an uptrend. - Trigger: CCI crosses back above -100, or turns up from the washout. - Stop: 2 ATR. - Target: 3R, with a 3 ATR trailing stop. - Lane: shadow Test lane, $1k split into 5 slots of $200.

## Komar momentum breakout

- Type: breakout | Family: galath | Style evidence (catalog): Momentum breakout
- Trades: US equities — 411-stock Galath universe (Signal Prism US 413 without its two crypto pairs)
- Timeframe: 1d
- Created by / source: Julian Komar's momentum method, the Galath / GrokBot desk's public-proxy screen
- Description (from source records): Komar momentum breakout
- Algorithm status: **FULL**
- Algorithm sources consulted: Test catalog entry/variants, Test strategies/galath/galath-komar-momentum.md, docs/KOMAR_MOMENTUM-RECREATE.md, dwj9ddyvf6-hub/Test strategies/galath/galath-komar-momentum.md, dwj9ddyvf6-hub/Test (main) strategies/galath/galath-komar-momentum.md — section '## Exit', Test docs/KOMAR_MOMENTUM-RECREATE.md, 2026-10-31 algorithm audit cure A (findings b1-entry, b2-exit, b3-sizing, b5-reconcile; quotes verbatim from cited sources)

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [galath-komar-momentum] Screen after the close (≥ 80 sessions): close > $5, 50-day dollar volume ≥ $20M, 20-day ADR ≥ 4%, ≥ 70% above the 52-week low, close above the 65-day EMA, the 8-day EMA above the 21-day. ### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [muse-grok-sr-spy] Zones: fractal swing pivots (5 bars each side) plus volume-at-price nodes (0.10 bins at or above the 90th percentile), clustered into 0.40 to 0.80 point bands; top 6 bands kept; the map is fixed for the session. Fade: price enters a band from outside, prints a rejection wick beyond the far edge of at least 50% of the bar range, and closes back inside the band or beyond its near edge, on volume above 1.5x the trailing 20-bar average. Breakout: a bar closes beyond the far edge by at least 0.10 with body at least 60% of range, volume above the prior bar and at least 1.2x the trailing 20-bar average. At most 3 entries a day; none at or after 11:30 ET.
  - [muse-grok-sr-spy] 5. Scan (fades first, across all live bands, then breakouts): a fade short fires when the prior close was below the band low, the bar high exceeds the band high, the upper wick is at least 50 percent of the bar range, the close is at or below the band high, and volume is above 1.5 times the trailing average. A fade long is mirrored at the band low. A breakout long fires when the prior close was at or below the band high, the close exceeds the band high by at least 0.10, the body is at least 60 percent of the range, and volume is above the prior bar's volume and at least 1.2 times the trailing average. A breakout short is mirrored at the band
- Exit rules:
  - [muse-grok-sr-spy] Stop beyond the band far edge by 0.10; target the nearest band edge in the trade direction or 2R, whichever is closer. - A close back through the band within 3 bars after the fill exits (reclaim invalidation); hard flat at 13:00 ET.
  - [muse-grok-sr-spy] 7. Management: hard flat first (at or after 13:00 ET, exit in full and mark the band dead). Then the reclaim invalidation: on bar indices entry_index+1 through entry_index+3, a close back through the band (above the band high for a fade short, below the band low for a fade long, back inside the band for a breakout) exits in full at the next open by desk convention, and the band dies. After 3 bars the reclaim rule lapses and the stop, target and hard flat govern (stop and target are carried as exit rules on the entry intent).
  - [muse-grok-sr-spy] - Stop beyond the band far edge by 0.10; target the nearest band edge in the trade direction or 2R, whichever is closer. - A close back through the band within 3 bars after the fill exits (reclaim invalidation); hard flat at 13:00 ET.

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:

Qualification: a 5-minute bar closes beyond the range on volume at least 1.5x the mean opening-range bar volume, by 12:00 ET. Qualification alone does not enter. Entry: a pullback of 1 to 6 bars toward the broken edge, no bar closing back inside the range and every pullback bar below the breakout bar's volume, then a trigger bar above the last pullback bar's volume; triggers must start before 12:30 ET.
  - [muse-teddy-orb-spy] 4. Setup replay (_scan), a deterministic replay of today's post-range bars: a breakout qualifies only at or before 12:00 ET when a 5-minute bar closes above OR high (long) or below OR low (short) with volume at least 1.5 times OR mean volume; a close through the range without that volume does not qualify. After a qualified breakout, a pullback bar is a counter-move close versus the prior bar; every pullback bar's volume must be below the breakout bar's volume (a pullback bar at or above it kills the setup), no bar may close back inside the range (that invalidation kills that direction for the session), and the pullback may run 1 to 6 bars. ## 55-bar trend breakout · 1d

- Type: breakout | Family: public_recipe | Style evidence (catalog): not recorded
- Trades: not recorded — not recorded in consulted sources
- Timeframe: not recorded
- Created by / source: not recorded
- Description (from source records): 55-bar trend breakout · 1d
- Algorithm status: **FULL**
- Algorithm sources consulted: ausar_map params/variant, md2 catalog entry/exit/strategy text, Test docs/AUSAR_PB157-RECREATE.md (Configuration section), Test docs/AUSAR_PB157-RECREATE.md (Full algorithm section), 2026-10-31 algorithm audit cure A (findings b1-entry, b2-exit, b3-sizing, b5-reconcile; quotes verbatim from cited sources)

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [ausar_pb157] Entry: close > max(previous_55_high) and close > sma200. Exit: close < min(previous_20_low) or close < sma200 or observed_quote_initial_2atr_stop or 126_completed_holding_bars.
- Exit rules:
  - [ausar_pb157] Sell below the prior twenty-bar low, below SMA200, at the initial two-ATR stop, or after 126 completed holding bars.
- Sizing:
  - [ausar_pb157] Session rth; cadence 86400 seconds; slice capital and cash $10,000; `bp_buffer_frac` 0.02; `flat_by_close` false; parked false. Paper only.
- Filters / data:
  - [ausar_pb157] data: Completed Yahoo bars, canonical v698 where applicable, actual received execution quotes.
- Parameters:
  - 1. Exits first, per held position, in this order: (a) initial stop: if the last close is at or below the position's recorded stop_price (from the position or its meta), sell in full with the observed_quote_initial_2atr_stop reason; (b) timeout: if bars held >= 126, sell in full (126_completed_holding_bars); (c) signal exits, requiring at least 252 bars: sell in full if the last close is below the prior 20-day low and/or below the 200-day SMA, with the triggered conditions named in the reason. If any exit is emitted, return with no entry.
  - 4. Sizing per candidate: cap = min(equity x 0.10, dollar_volume20 x 0.01, available cash), where available cash starts as the slice cash and is reduced by held positions at their average prices and by each new entry in this evaluation; shares = int(cap // price), then capped by the risk size int((equity x 0.005) // (2.0 x ATR14)); fewer than 1 share emits nothing.

### Variants (1)
- **base form (variant zero)**: base strategy as documented; no distinct variant recorded
  - aliases: ausar_pb157

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [qm-episodic-pivot] Pool: 20-day dollar volume ≥ $5M and a 126-session return ≤ 30%, while QQQ is risk-on. Open: gap ≥ 10% over the last close and first-20-minute volume ≥ 0.5× the 20-day average. Catalyst: a verified 8-K / 6-K public before the trigger minute. Trigger: from minute 20, price crosses the opening-range high; stop = the low before the trigger bar, within 1 ATR.
  - [qm-episodic-pivot] Buys a quiet stock that gaps up 10% or more on a verified catalyst with heavy early volume, when it takes out the opening-range high from minute 20.
- Exit rules:
  - [qm-episodic-pivot] Hard stop at the entry stop. - After the third session held, in profit: sells a third (at the close) and moves the stop to breakeven. - After 3 sessions, a close below the 10-day SMA (the 20-day when the close is more than 1.5 ATR above the 10-day) exits at the next open.
  - [qm-episodic-pivot] 7. Exit, trailing rule: after 3 sessions, a close below the 10-day SMA (the 20-day when the close is more than 1.5 ATR above the 10-day) exits at the next open.
  - [qm-episodic-pivot] - Hard stop at the entry stop. - After the third session held, in profit: sells a third (at the close) and moves the stop to breakeven. - After 3 sessions, a close below the 10-day SMA (the 20-day when the close is more than 1.5 ATR above the 10-day) exits at the next open.
- Sizing:
  - [qm-episodic-pivot] Book: $100,000. Sizing: 0.35% of the session's opening equity on the stressed loss per share (stop distance + the 95th-percentile adverse overnight gap over 126 sessions + round-trip friction); capped at 20% of equity per name, 100% gross, 25% per sector, 4% total open risk, 1% of 20-day dollar volume, 15 positions.
- Filters / data:
  - [qm-episodic-pivot] - Genome daily bars, 1-minute tapes, SEC EDGAR current reports (acceptance time), per the card.
- Parameters:
  - Pool: 20-day dollar volume ≥ $5M and a 126-session return ≤ 30%, while QQQ is risk-on.

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [mk-multidaygoldengateweekly] Levels from last week's close (PC) and the weekly ATR(14): entry at the gate, PC ± 0.382 ATR; target ± 0.618; stop PC. The week's first gate touch decides: it trades only with the prior bar's Phase Oscillator above 61.8 (long) or below -61.8 (short) and the liquidity gate. Phase Oscillator = EMA(3) of (close - EMA21) / (3 × ATR14) × 100.
  - [mk-multidaygoldengateweekly] 2. Entry: the period's first touch of the entry level, anchor +/- 0.382 x ATR, in the touch direction, decides the period once (done_period: a period is decided once and entered once); entry_lvl = 0.382.
- Exit rules:
  - [mk-multidaygoldengateweekly] Target or stop by touch (on the entry bar the stop counts only on a close through it); otherwise flat at the week's last close.
  - [mk-multidaygoldengateweekly] 5. Execution phases: watch (open to close-16) runs the open phase then the touch phase on the session range so far (stop entries, voids, stops, targets and touch exits executed at once); close (close-15 to close-11) runs the touch phase again then the close phase on the provisional bar, market-on-close; after (after the close) runs the completed bar, with late events executing at the next open. An entry on a period's last session that does not exit on that bar is closed at that session's close (named divergence 7 in the module header).
  - [mk-multidaygoldengateweekly] - Target or stop by touch (on the entry bar the stop counts only on a close through it); otherwise flat at the week's last close.

  - [mk-multidaygoldengateweekly] Sizing (daily module header): the study has none (per trade, equal weight, every signal taken); the desk rendering is a fixed $10,000 per trade on a $1,000,000 virtual book (NOTIONAL = 10,000.0, CAPITAL = 1,000,000.0); each lane keeps its own trade ledger and the sleeve trades the net per symbol.

## bta_onebar_qqq

- Type: breakout | Family: bta_onebar | Style evidence (catalog): not recorded
- Trades: QQQ — US equities
- Timeframe: 30-minute bars
- Created by / source: Breakout Trading Academy X post, 2026-10-30 (per docs/BTA-ONEBAR-ALGORITHM.md provenance)
- Description (from source records): One-bar Donchian breakout on QQQ: 50-bar channel breakout entry on 30-minute bars, hold one bar, exit at the next bar's open; $10,000 sleeve slice, paper only. Algorithm 1 of docs/BTA-ONEBAR-ALGORITHM.md; recreation package docs/BTA_ONEBAR_QQQ-RECREATE.md.
- Algorithm status: **FULL**
- Algorithm sources consulted: Test docs/BTA-ONEBAR-ALGORITHM.md, Test docs/SLEEVES.json roster row, live desk roster config muse-desk-v3/config/sleeves.json, 2026-10-31 algorithm audit cure B (findings b6-roster)

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [bta_onebar_qqq] If the latest completed bar's high is at or above the channel high, a long entry fills at the channel high, or at that bar's open if the bar opened above the channel high. If the latest bar's low is at or below the channel low, a short entry fills at the channel low, or at that bar's open if it opened below it. If the bar spans both extremes, no entry. One position at a time. An entry is counted on the entry bar's ET date; at most 2 entries per day, and entries are only taken on the current session's bars. (docs/BTA-ONEBAR-ALGORITHM.md, Algorithm 1 step 2)
- Exit rules:
  - [bta_onebar_qqq] Protective stop: Long: entry x 0.998. Short: entry x 1.002. No target, no trailing rule. Time exit: a position entered on bar T exits in full at the open of bar T+1, at market, with the closing position intent (sell_to_close for a long, buy_to_close for a short). No re-entry in the same bar as an exit. (docs/BTA-ONEBAR-ALGORITHM.md, Algorithm 1 steps 4-5)
- Sizing:
  - [bta_onebar_qqq] qty = floor(slice equity / entry price), whole shares. If the live snapshot carries no slice, the configured $10,000 slice is used. The $10,000 slice is the notional cap and the binding sizing constraint. (docs/BTA-ONEBAR-ALGORITHM.md, Algorithm 1 step 3 and translation table)
- Filters / data:
  - [bta_onebar_qqq] Channel gate: the prior 50 completed bars before the latest completed bar; fewer than 51 completed bars in total: no action. No filters and no other rules (family summary). data: 30-minute bars from the desk warm product (Alpaca SIP); inputs bars, bars_30min, bars:QQQ:30Min, positions, quotes, session_fills.
- Parameters:
  - 50-bar Donchian channel; 30-minute bars; stop 0.20 percent (long entry x 0.998, short entry x 1.002); max 2 entries/day; slice $10,000; cadence 60 seconds; parked false; paper only.
  - Instrument: QQQ shares, long and short. Timeframe: 30-minute bars, completed bars only, every bar in the desk warm product for QQQ.

- Filters / data:
  - [bta_onebar_basket] Per-symbol channel gate identical to Algorithm 1 (prior 50 completed bars; fewer than 51 completed bars in total: no action for that symbol). - Parameters:
  - 50-bar Donchian channel per symbol; 30-minute bars; stop 0.20 percent; max 2 entries/day per symbol (8 across the basket); up to 4 positions at once; slice $10,000; cadence 60 seconds; parked false; paper only.

- Description (from source records): One-bar Donchian breakout on QQQ, regular session only: Algorithm 1 computed only on RTH bars (09:30 to before 16:00 ET) with a 15:55 ET flat; $10,000 sleeve slice, paper only. Algorithm 3 of docs/BTA-ONEBAR-ALGORITHM.md; recreation package docs/BTA_ONEBAR_RTH-RECREATE.md.
- Algorithm status: **FULL**
- Algorithm sources consulted: Test docs/BTA-ONEBAR-ALGORITHM.md, Test docs/SLEEVES.json roster row, live desk roster config muse-desk-v3/config/sleeves.json, 2026-10-31 algorithm audit cure B (findings b6-roster)

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [bta_onebar_rth] Identical to Algorithm 1 (50-bar channel breakout entry on 30-minute completed bars; at most 2 entries per day; one position at a time) with session restrictions: entries only during RTH, which follows from the bar filter: no bar outside the session can trigger an entry. (docs/BTA-ONEBAR-ALGORITHM.md, Algorithm 3)
- Exit rules:
  - [bta_onebar_rth] Algorithm 1 exits (protective stop entry x 0.998 long / entry x 1.002 short, no target, no trailing rule; time exit in full at the open of bar T+1) plus: 15:55 ET flat. Any position still open at 15:55 ET exits at market at that time, instead of the next-bar-open exit carrying it past the close. This flat is the sleeve's own rule (config flat_by_close stays false), so there is exactly one flatten path. (docs/BTA-ONEBAR-ALGORITHM.md, Algorithm 3)
- Sizing:
  - [bta_onebar_rth] Identical to Algorithm 1: qty = floor(slice equity / entry price), whole shares. If the live snapshot carries no slice, the configured $10,000 slice is used. Slice: $10,000. (docs/BTA-ONEBAR-ALGORITHM.md, Algorithm 3 with Algorithm 1 step 3)
- Filters / data:
  - [bta_onebar_rth] RTH bars only: the channel and all entry decisions are computed only on bars whose start time is from 09:30 ET to before 16:00 ET. Premarket and after-hours bars in the warm product are ignored entirely. Plus the Algorithm 1 channel gate (prior 50 completed bars; fewer than 51: no action). data: 30-minute bars from the desk warm product (Alpaca SIP); inputs bars, bars_30min, bars:QQQ:30Min, positions, quotes, session_fills.
- Parameters:
  - 50-bar Donchian channel on RTH bars only; 30-minute bars; stop 0.20 percent; max 2 entries/day; 15:55 ET flat; slice $10,000; cadence 60 seconds; parked false; paper only.

Pivots: a bar strictly highest (or lowest) over 5 bars each side (k=5), usable only once those 5 right-side bars have closed (anti-repaint). Setup: two consecutive same-kind pivots of the same day, 10-120 bars apart, with a regular divergence against the MACD(12, 26, 9) line (MACD divergence is required); RSI(14) divergence and lower volume on the second extreme add to the divergence count (1-3). Trigger (bearish): A = the lowest low between the highs, B = the second high; entry when price trades through B - 0.236 x (B - A) - 1 tick ($0.01); bullish mirrored. Exit: stop one tick beyond B, checked before the targets on the same bar (pessimistic ordering). TP1 at 38.2%: half off and the stop moves to the entry. TP2 at 61.8%: the rest. Flat at 12:00 ET.
- Sizing:
  - [t_trullas] 7. Sizing: divergence count times 0.25% of the slice at risk to the stop, capped at 25% of the slice in notional; whole shares.

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [t_trullas_v08] Primary Trullas entry (QQQ 1-minute bars, RTH 09:30-16:00 ET, zero-volume bars dropped): pivots strictly highest/lowest over a 2k+1 window with k=5, usable only at confirm_index = pivot index + 5; pairs are two consecutive confirmed pivots of the same kind, same trading day, 10 to 120 bars apart; regular divergence with MACD(12,26,9) divergence REQUIRED (bearish: price second high > first, MACD second < first; RSI(14) and volume divergences counted, count 1 to 3). Fibonacci geometry: bearish A = lowest low between the two highs, B = second pivot high, level(p) = B - p x (B - A); bullish mirrored. Entry trigger = level(0.236) minus $0.01 (bearish) / plus $0.01 (bullish). Entry gates: latest b
- Exit rules:

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [apex-o1-convex] L* = the APEX-50F target on the last finished session (trend score × min(4, 50% / volatility)). Core: QQQ at min(L*, 1) with a 0.20 band. Calls for the rest (L* - 1): at the money, the expiry nearest 91 days, delta-sized: want × NAV / (delta × spot) shares. O1: re-struck at each month's first session or when the calls' delta exposure is 0.5 off the want (expiry ≥ 45 days, delta > 0.05). O1b: opens at a want ≥ 0.5 (expiry ≥ 60 days, at most 99.5% of NAV in premium), then adjusts the held call by whole contracts when 0.5 off.
- Exit rules:
  - [apex-o1-convex] 4. Re-strike at each month's first session or when the calls' delta exposure differs from want by at least 0.5: close all calls and, if want > 0, reopen at the expiry nearest 91 days (at least 45 days), strike = spot, only if delta > 0.05. 5. Opens only when want >= 0.5: expiry nearest 91 days (at least 60 days), size min(want x NAV / (delta x spot), 99.5% of NAV / price). 6. A held call is closed / rolled when it has under 45 days left or its delta is outside 0.30-0.85; otherwise, when |want - have| >= 0.5, adjust the held call by whole contracts toward the target (toward 0 when nothing is wanted). Exit: O1 closes the calls on a re-strike with nothing wanted; O1b rolls under 45 days or outs
- Sizing:
  - [apex-o1-convex] The core trades market-on-close on the equity less the options' value; a $1,000,000 book.

  - [apex-o1-convex] 5. Opens only when want >= 0.5: expiry nearest 91 days (at least 60 days), size min(want x NAV / (delta x spot), 99.5% of NAV / price).

Live QQQ quote and option chain; a model surface from VXN and the VIX 9-day / 3-month / 6-month ratios at today's levels; Black-Scholes with a 0.55% dividend yield.

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:

Enters on event day + 3 sessions, 09:35-09:40 ET: puts with 21-35 DTE, delta 0.50-0.65; verticals sell the strike nearest spot × 0.95.

- Exit rules:
  - [opt-pead] Planned exit on the 10th session counting the entry day; pre-expiry exit the session before expiry.

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [opt-qqq95-rsi2] Buys the QQQ core once: 95% of initial capital at the ask. Overlay: the RSI2 recovery signal (close > SMA200, RSI(2) < 10), 09:35-09:40 ET, 14-21 DTE calls of delta 0.50-0.60.
  - [opt-qqq95-rsi2] 7. Debit and gates: Long premium check: reject if debit / spot is above 0.015 (the code tests (debit x 100) / (spot x 100) against max_premium_spot 0.015), where debit is the long leg ask. Reject a debit at or below 0. Core spread gate (enhancement, on by default): refuse if the long leg ask minus bid is above 25% of its ask.
- Exit rules:
  - [opt-qqq95-rsi2] Overlay: exit on the 5th session counting the entry day, or on a 2% touch of the underlying; the core is held.
  - [opt-qqq95-rsi2] 1. Exits first, for held positions that carry option legs. In order: (a) pre-expiry guard: exit if the first leg expiry is 1 day or less from the current session; (b) planned session exit: exit if sessions held is at or above 5 (sessions held is taken from the position, or counted from daily bars after the entry date); (c) touch exit (exit_rule 'touch'): exit if the underlying last daily close is at or above entry_spot x 1.02. An exit is a full sell_to_close package reversing the legs. A position with no legs (the QQQ equity core) is skipped: there is no exit rule for it.
  - [opt-qqq95-rsi2] - Overlay: exit on the 5th session counting the entry day, or on a 2% touch of the underlying; the core is held.
- Sizing:
  - [aster_core_rsi2_long] v3 slice: {"capital_usd": 10000.0, "cash_usd": 10000.0} parked=False
  - [aster_core_rsi2_vertical] v3 slice: {"capital_usd": 10000.0, "cash_usd": 10000.0} parked=False

Debit and gates: Long premium check: reject if debit / spot is above 0.015 (the code tests (debit x 100) / (spot x 100) against max_premium_spot 0.015), where debit is the long leg ask. Reject a debit at or below 0. Core spread gate (enhancement, on by default): refuse if the long leg ask minus bid is above 25% of its ask.
  - [opt-qqq95-rsi2] 7. Debit and gates: Vertical debit check: debit per share = long ask minus wing bid; reject if debit / width is above 0.45, where width is the absolute strike difference. Reject a debit at or below 0. Core spread gate (enhancement, on by default): refuse if the long leg ask minus bid is above 25% of its ask.

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [mk-creativetensoroptionexpressionproxy] Weekly fire: a closed weekly Tensor bar with a buy-cyan or buy-green marker (bar ≥ 60). Tier A: at least 2 of (close ≤ $14.94; that and a 60-day return ≥ 31%; ≥ 70% under the 252-day high; an SMH-sector name), not XLF, XLB, XLRE or XLU; 60-day realised volatility 5-400%; 20-day dollar volume ≥ $100,000. The listed call with the expiry nearest 52 weeks (≥ 75% of it) and the strike nearest the fire close, two-sided, bought the session after the fire week with a limit 2% over the ask for an hour; ask ≥ 2% of spot.
  - [mk-creativetensoroptionexpressionproxy] 4. Entry timing: a fire enters on the session after its fire week (entry_on = the session after the fire's last session); the shared FireBook machinery enters only in the first 90 minutes of a session, marks a fire seen on its entry session, and treats a fire first seen more than 1 session late as missed (logged when at most 5 sessions late). If no chain is available for the name this pass, the fire is retried on a later pass instead of being marked seen.
- Exit rules:
  - [mk-creativetensoroptionexpressionproxy] After 52 weeks (or the expiry's last session if sooner), a marketable order that session.
  - [mk-creativetensoroptionexpressionproxy] Tier-A weekly Tensor Cyan / Green fires on the 1,822 store_v1 survivor names, expressed with listed calls instead of stock: one-year at-the-money calls, $1,000 of premium per fire, sold after 52 weeks. Book $1,000,000. - Type: options directional | Family: muse | Style evidence (catalog): Expected-move levels
- Trades: SPY options (0DTE) — SPY (QQQ confirms)
- Timeframe: 5m
- Created by / source: Azrael's 15.87 Rule, reverse-engineered from his worksheet
- Description (from source records): 15.87 Rule - SPY same-day options
- Algorithm status: **FULL**
- Algorithm sources consulted: Test catalog entry/variants, ausar_map params/variant, femto land-wt config params, md2 catalog entry/exit/strategy text, muse-desk-v3 roster params/slice, Test docs/EM_1587-RECREATE.md (Configuration section), Test sleeves/em_1587.py

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [ausar_pb9] Expected move in SPY points = prior SPY close × (prior VIX close ÷ 15.87 ÷ 100), rounded to 0.1. Map walls at ±1 expected move, shelves at ±0.5, and prior close as the magnet. Below VIX 15, fade the edges. From 15 to 18.5, trade only a same-bar SPY/QQQ break beyond their first-20-minute ranges. Above 18.5, do not fade and halve size. Enter 09:50-11:05 ET; one setup per session.
  - [em_1587] sleeve-owned (sleeves/em_1587.py)
- Exit rules:
  - [ausar_pb9] Break: target the next mapped level; invalidate on a 5-minute close back inside the opening range. Fade: target prior SPY close; exit on a 5-minute close half an expected move beyond the wall. Flat 11:30 ET.
  - [em_1587] sleeve-owned exit intents
- Sizing:
  - [em_1587] v3 slice: {"capital_usd": 10000.0, "cash_usd": 10000.0} parked=False
- Filters / data:
  - [ausar_pb9] data: Prior VIX and SPY closes, completed SPY and QQQ 5-minute opening ranges, mapped SPY levels, option-chain metadata and open-interest snapshot, and the session clock.
  - [em_1587] data: WARMUP_BARS={"5Min": 78}
- Parameters:
  - Universe: SPY (traded) with QQQ as the confirmation symbol. Asset: SPY 0DTE options. Timeframe: 5m bars; entries 09:50 to 11:05 ET; hard flat 11:30 ET.
  - Sizing / slice: capital_usd 10000.0, cash_usd 10000.0 in the roster row; risk_pct 0.04 in CONFIG (4 percent of the slice in premium, half in the FAST regime).
  - Cadence: 60 seconds. Session: rth. flat_by_close: false; flatten_time_et: null; bp_buffer_frac: 0.02; params: {} in the roster row.
  - BUDGET_PCT = 0.04              # DC-8: premium budget per entry

Alignment: both MACDs on the same side of their signal lines across the stack; dominance runs slowest to fastest, and the dominant direction must agree before entry. Long premium only: bullish buys calls, bearish buys puts. No spreads, no short premium.
  - [muse-investandbefree-dmac] Sizing (qty_for_position): if ask * 100 exceeds 25% of slice capital (ctx.equity), qty is 0 and there is no trade; otherwise qty = floor(2000 / (ask * 100)), further capped to floor(0.25 * capital / (ask * 100)). - Exit rules:
  - [muse-investandbefree-dmac] Partial at +100% into a runner; runner exits on a daily MACD-E cross against or at 5 DTE. - Premium stop 50%; spread gate 10% (recreated defaults, frozen in the desk spec).

Score: F = 0.3 SES + 0.4 30M + 0.22 10M + 0.08 5M, persistence and price-agreement adjustments, pin and run adjustments. Hysteresis: entry at absolute score 25 or more, flip at opposing 35 or more, drop below 8 plus 600,000 ms; window 09:45 to 15:45 ET (recreated hard gate).

Exit: if quantity is open and (time is at or after 15:45, or the call changed to a different direction than the position), emit one full exit Intent (sell_to_close / buy_to_close) and clear open_call. Grading helpers (not traded): grade_cal
- Exit rules:
  - [muse-przm-zero] Per the hysteresis rules above; sign-only 30-minute grading counts right and wrong calls.

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [ausar_pb12] Golden Gate: take the first 38.2% level crossing in either direction when the session opens inside the level. Trigger: take the first 3-minute close above +23.6% when the session opens inside ±23.6%; this trigger is bullish only. The completed 1-hour Phase Oscillator is recorded but does not gate entry. Enter 09:35–14:30 ET and at least 90 minutes before the actual close.
  - [ausar_pb13] Golden Gate: take the first 38.2% level crossing in either direction when the session opens inside the level. Trigger: take the first 3-minute close above +23.6% when the session opens inside ±23.6%; this trigger is bullish only. The completed 1-hour Phase Oscillator is recorded but does not gate entry. Enter 09:35–14:30 ET and at least 90 minutes before the actual close.
  - [saty_sol] sleeve-owned (sleeves/saty_sol.py)
  - [saty_sol_0dte] sleeve-owned (sleeves/saty_sol_0dte.py)
- Exit rules:
  - [ausar_pb12] Golden Gate: exit all at 61.8% or on a post-fill 10-minute close through adverse 23.6%. Trigger: exit at 38.2% or on a post-fill 3-minute close through adverse 23.6%. No partials. Flatten 10 minutes before close and never carry through expiry.
  - [ausar_pb13] Golden Gate: exit all at 61.8% or on a post-fill 10-minute close through the adverse 23.6% level. Trigger: exit at 38.2% or on a post-fill 3-minute close through adverse 23.6%. No partials. Flatten 10 minutes before close; the 1% daily-loss halt blocks entries, not exits.
  - [saty_sol] sleeve-owned exit intents
  - [saty_sol_0dte] sleeve-owned exit intents

  - [saty_sol] v3 slice: {"capital_usd": 10000.0, "cash_usd": 10000.0} parked=False
  - [saty_sol_0dte] v3 slice: {"capital_usd": 10000.0, "cash_usd": 10000.0} parked=False

  - [ausar_pb12] data: Frozen prior SPY close and ATR(14), completed daily, 1-hour, 10-minute and 3-minute bars, current SPY price, same-day SPY options and fresh quotes, and the actual session close.
  - [ausar_pb13] data: Frozen prior SPY close and ATR(14), completed daily, 1-hour, 10-minute and 3-minute bars, current SPY price, listed SPY options and fresh quotes, and the actual session close.
